extracted.name: Argentinean Chimichurri
extracted.description: This chimichurri recipe with lemon is the simplest way to make the authentic Argentinean side. It is the perfect pairing for your Argentinean dish.
ingredient_lines: Salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Stir olive oil and lemon juice together with garlic, shallot, parsley, basil, thyme, and oregano; season to taste with salt and pepper. Allow to stand for 2 hours at room temperature before serving; store remaining chimichurri in refrigerator.
